disposition_meaning: The literal O1-C07 gap - path-level opens AND their measurement basis - could NOT be closed. Two lawful unprivileged interposition mechanisms were attempted; plain symbol definition does not interpose dyld shared-cache symbols, and __DATA,__interpose crashes CPython at startup on both available interpreters for open, stat and even a cold getpid. The blocker is PRESERVED and no count was fabricated. One account WAS closed: SRC26 header-prefix reads have an executable Python-level owner, were exercised, and an excess read was refused before execution. Selected-read has no executable owner. Byte accounting is partial.
